A '''memory circuit''' was a component in [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Prima" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series protocol droid]] [[TC-9D0]] held sensitive information regarding a [[Politics/Legends|politician's]] personal affairs within his memory circuits.<ref name="Prima" />
